policy: Archive completed FAIL and nonzero exits unchanged. Pending/missing receipts are never PASS. No original evidence is deleted or overwritten.
compression: All tools/logs/text/patches gzip with mtime=0; JSON >=32KiB gzip; rawSha256 verifies decompressed bytes.
limits: Allowlisted file preservation only. Packaging does not turn a test, manual review, CI or deployment into PASS. Explicit screenshot replacements retain prior source/SHA and override evidence; only prior Home375/Quotation375 may be separate bug PNG evidence. 300dpi QR diagnostic images and caches are excluded.
